definitions.explanation: An organized armed resistance against an established authority or government. Also used figuratively for strong defiance.

examples.japanese: {反乱|はんらん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{反乱|はんらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鎮圧|ちんあつ}→鎮圧：14542_chinatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{農民|のうみん}→農民：03759_noumin⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}え→耐える：12087_taeru⟧かねて{反乱|はんらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: The farmers, unable to bear the heavy taxes, raised a revolt.

notes:
Distinguished from the homophone ⟦{氾濫|はんらん}→氾濫：09256_hanran⟧ (flood, overflow). {反乱|はんらん} specifically refers to armed resistance or revolt against authority.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反乱|はんらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ — to stage a rebellion
- {反乱|はんらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鎮圧|ちんあつ}→鎮圧：14542_chinatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to suppress a rebellion
- {反乱|はんらん}{軍|ぐん} — rebel army
- {反乱|はんらん}⟦{分子|ぶんし}→分子：11769_bunshi⟧ — rebel element, insurgent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暴動|ぼうどう}→暴動：15533_boudou⟧ — riot (more spontaneous, less organized)
- ⟦{謀反|むほん}→謀反：14455_muhon⟧ — treason, revolt (historical, against a lord)
- ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧ — revolution (larger scale, aims to change the system)
